parameters.note: Dollar Reservoir is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake/reservoir regulation in §5.85(a)(1) (open all year). The reservoir is a dammed impoundment on Dollar Creek (OSM shows the dam and Dollar Creek entering above and continuing below the reservoir), just above Dollar Hill northwest of Tahoe City; Dollar Creek flows into Lake Tahoe and is a Lake Tahoe tributary. The Tahoe tributary special regulation, §7.50(b)(152)(A), covers 'Tahoe Lake tributaries upstream to the first lake' — Dollar Reservoir is that first lake, so the special closure governs Dollar Creek below the reservoir, not the reservoir itself. The reservoir therefore follows the general reservoir regulation.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake/reservoir regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water). Dollar Reservoir is the first-lake impoundment on Dollar Creek, a Lake Tahoe tributary, but the §7.50(b)(152) tributary closure applies only to Dollar Creek below the reservoir, not to the reservoir itself.

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license. Dollar Reservoir is wholly within California (Placer Co.); no Nevada reciprocity applies to this reservoir. Note: the reservoir sits within the Tahoe City Public Utility District service area near Dollar Hill; no authoritative source confirming public fishing access was located, so no access rule is asserted here.

candidates.summary: California sport fishing license required for anglers 16+
